thesis.title: AMD event research thesis
thesis.thesis: Q2 2024 baseline: AMD-Q2-REV=5835 USD million; AMD-Q2-GM=49 %; AMD-Q2-GAME=648 USD million. Track total-company growth and GAAP margin alongside Gaming segment risk; do not infer a sustained recovery from one improved quarter.

event.summary: AMD Q4 2024 SEC event packet: AMD-Q4-REV=7658 USD million; AMD-Q4-GM=51 %; AMD-Q4-GAME=563 USD million.

reviews.rationale: Q4 2024 vs Q2 2024 baseline: total revenue rose 5835→7658 USD million (+31.2%) and GAAP gross margin improved 49%→51%, supporting both the revenue-growth and margin-resilience catalysts. Gaming revenue recovered to 563 USD million from the Q3 trough of 462, though it remains below the Q2 baseline of 648 (−13.1%), so 'sustained segment weakness' remains a live risk rather than fully resolved. All three required metrics (quarterly_revenue, gross_margin, gaming_revenue) are present; no required evidence is missing. Net effect is positive on total-company growth and margin, tempered by Gaming still below baseline. Maintain thesis at conviction 3; do not infer a sustained recovery from limited quarters.
